parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: The frequency at which readable characteristics refreshed

parameter.name: alwaysConnected
parameter.label: Connect Automatically
parameter.description: If enabled, will automatically connect to the device and reconnect if connection is lost.

parameter.name: connectionSecurity
parameter.label: Connection Security
parameter.description: LE connection security for this device. "none" (default) connects unbonded with no encryption — the proven, dead-stable profile suitable for open sensors. "auto" requests Just-Works encryption (no passkey/MITM) for devices whose characteristics require an encrypted link. Leave on "none" unless a device actually rejects reads without encryption. NOTE: "auto" is EXPERIMENTAL — the encrypted connection works, but a device that distributes an identity/IRK on pairing may not reconnect reliably after a drop (an address-resolution limitation); the adapter detects this and automatically falls back to an unencrypted connection for that device so it stays usable. Currently honoured by the Direct-BT adapter; other adapters ignore it.
